scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../ml && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:realtime: cd server && npm install ws axios && cd ../client && npm install chart.js react-chartjs-2 && cd ../ml && pip install flask-cors
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run start:ml" "npm run start:client"
scripts.help:
echo "Available commands:
  npm run install:all - Install all dependencies
  npm run install:realtime - Install real-time feature dependencies
  npm run start:server - Start Node.js backend
  npm run start:ml - Start Python ML service
  npm run start:client - Start React frontend
  npm run test:websocket - Test WebSocket connection
  npm run dev - Start all services (requires concurrently)"
